facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says eMarketer data shows steep growth in time spent with media until 2022, with the growth beginning to uptick in 2020.
facts.quote: Data from eMarketer shows steep growth in time spent with media up until 2022.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says time spent with digital media plateaued after the first year of the pandemic.
facts.quote: After that first year of the pandemic, this growth started to plateau.

facts.fact: A StackAdapt chart shows hours and minutes spent on media per day per US adult over the period 2013 to 2025.
facts.quote: graph showing hours and minutes spent on media per day per US adult from 2013 to 2025

facts.fact: Citing McKinsey, StackAdapt says generative AI's impact on productivity could add trillions of dollars in value to the global economy.
facts.quote: generative AI’s impact on productivity could add trillions of dollars in value to the global economy

facts.fact: In an exclusive research report by StackAdapt and Advertiser Perceptions, media buyers in 2023 reported difficulty measuring their goals across different channels.
facts.quote: media buyers in 2023 found that they have difficulty measuring their goals across different channels

facts.fact: A StackAdapt bar graph shows that cross-channel measurement is the top multi-channel challenge for advertisers in the US.
facts.quote: A bar graph illustrating how cross-channel measurement is the top multi-channel challenge for advertisers in the US

facts.fact: This StackAdapt blog post was published on December 14, 2023.
